cases.core_model: Members club combining serious training, boutique studios and broader hospitality-style club life.
cases.target_members: Premium urban members seeking training plus lifestyle amenities.
cases.service_mechanism: Integrated training and club services under one membership proposition.
cases.community_mechanism: Member-club environment and shared lifestyle spaces.
cases.why_it_may_work: Multiple use cases can increase visit frequency and perceived membership value; validate actual utilization before copying.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Study how much hospitality should surround a performance-first club. Prioritize training capability before broad lifestyle expansion.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not assume a large luxury footprint or hospitality build-out is appropriate for an urban performance club.
cases.investment_decision: Study; selectively build after demand validation

cases.core_model: Social wellness positioning around recovery and self-care experiences.
cases.target_members: Urban consumers interested in wellness services and shared experiences.
cases.service_mechanism: Bookable wellness services with a social-club framing.
cases.community_mechanism: Group and social experiences around wellness.
cases.why_it_may_work: A shared ritual may make recovery more social and repeatable than isolated equipment use.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Test recovery as an add-on to running and strength communities before investing in a full standalone recovery facility.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not infer clinical efficacy from brand positioning; assess each modality and its evidence separately.

cases.type: Athletic Country Club / family, sport and lifestyle destination
cases.core_model: Opened 2026-10-12; over 180,000 sq ft across 86,000-sq-ft club, ~50,000-sq-ft beach club and ~50,000-sq-ft pickleball retreat; 14 pickleball courts and integrated training, recovery, hospitality, coworking and childcare.
cases.target_members: Affluent suburban households and multi-generational families seeking sport, leisure, work and wellness in one destination.
cases.service_mechanism: Combines personal training, group classes, recovery, chiropractic clinic, cafe, coworking and Kids Academy; member app and athletic events extend service beyond the site.
cases.community_mechanism: Family recreation, 14 pickleball courts, pool/beach social areas and club events create repeatable non-gym reasons to visit.
cases.why_it_may_work: Bundling multiple household activities can increase use cases, convenience and perceived membership value; specific retention and economics are not disclosed.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Build the service logic of a daily-life club: good changing/recovery fundamentals, member lounge, events and a testable family-friendly schedule. Treat sport and childcare as conditional demand-driven modules.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy the 180,000-sq-ft destination scale, beach club, 14 courts or full Kids Academy into a dense urban flagship without proven local demand and site economics.
cases.investment_decision: Build core training and service; partner or pilot family/sports extensions; defer resort-scale amenities.
cases.evidence_status: High for opening, floor areas and announced facilities (official 2026-10-12 release); low for long-term retention or financial outcomes.

cases.type: Performance & recovery club / integrated longevity partnership
cases.core_model: Operating performance wellness club integrating strength and HYROX training, classes, recovery, health diagnostics and a work/social cafe within tiered memberships.
cases.target_members: Performance-focused urban professionals, HYROX participants and members seeking integrated recovery and health insights.
investment_modules: Performance gym floor and HYROX outdoor zone
Cold plunge, saunas, compression and other recovery modalities
The Circle cafe/coworking and membership app
cases.service_mechanism: All published tiers include gym and recovery; higher tiers add unlimited group classes or Reformer sessions; personal training and longevity diagnostics are additional service layers.
cases.community_mechanism: The Circle lounge/cafe, HYROX group training, events and guest passes create shared participation and member connections.
cases.why_it_may_work: Clear differentiation between access, coached classes and premium specialty services can support upgrades; no independent utilization or retention data yet.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Study three-layer membership architecture: train + basic recovery; coached performance; optional professional assessment. Build coaching, partner for specialist medical/diagnostic work and pilot recovery utilization.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not assume unlimited hyperbaric oxygen, cryotherapy or red-light access has proven training benefit or economic sustainability; evaluate safety, evidence and service capacity separately.
cases.investment_decision: Build coaching and training; partner clinical diagnostics; pilot recovery, defer advanced modalities pending evidence.
cases.evidence_status: High for official listed facilities, membership tiers and operating claim; medium for service delivery; low for independently verified performance/health benefits.

cases.type: Hotel x wellness membership / recovery and performance services
cases.core_model: Hotel wellness concept announced 2026-10-04, planned to open 2026-10-30: over 2,275 sq m across two floors, combining spa, fitness, recovery, visiting specialists and private wellness memberships.
cases.target_members: Luxury hotel guests and affluent local residents seeking a long-term premium wellness relationship.
investment_modules: AlterG anti-gravity treadmill and Technogym Biostrength
Posture analysis and specialist fitness consultations
Family wellness programming and hotel-suite wellness details
cases.service_mechanism: Planned private Wellness Membership plus visiting expert consultations, tailored programs and hotel-guest access.
cases.community_mechanism: Workshops, specialist residencies and family experiences; social and nature-connection pillars are announced but not yet independently evaluated.
cases.why_it_may_work: Hospitality assets and visiting specialists can extend a hotel into local repeat memberships; not yet proven because the venue has not opened as of 2026-10-26.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Consider rotating expert-in-residence collaborations, periodic athlete assessment days and hotel partnerships for race-weekend recovery rather than owning every specialist service.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not build hotel-scale spa, high-cost medical-style technologies or full family programming based on an untested pre-opening concept.
cases.investment_decision: Partner for visiting specialists and medical assessments; pilot workshops; defer hotel-scale spa and specialized hardware.
cases.evidence_status: High for official 2026-10-04 announced plans; operating status and member uptake unverified before scheduled 2026-10-30 opening.

cases.city: New York City, New York, USA
cases.type: Community-led running club / coached training and partner-benefit membership
cases.core_model: Established running community with 2026 paid memberships bundling training sessions, races, partner discounts, limited race-bib opportunities and a club singlet; separate private coaching and marathon plans.
cases.target_members: Urban runners seeking structured group sessions, community identity, race access and training progression.
investment_modules: Specialist running coach and weekly programming
cases.service_mechanism: Official 2026 site lists annual membership billed $55/month, solidarity membership $400/year, and private coaching $255/month with additional race-specific plans.
cases.community_mechanism: Three weekly practices, community events, race participation, sponsor partnerships and a solidarity tier supporting member access.
cases.why_it_may_work: Recurring practice plus identity, partner perks and event access may create a durable reason to belong even without owning an expensive facility; actual retention not disclosed.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Build a runner/road-to-trail training calendar and club identity with coach-led sessions, race services and partner perks. Keep private coaching and race-specific plans separately priced.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not assume a community-led club membership price or sponsorship terms transfer directly to a premium full-service gym; verify rights to race bibs and brand partnerships.
cases.investment_decision: Build coaching and community; partner events, retail and race services; defer dedicated track/venue until participation proves demand.
cases.evidence_status: High for current official membership offer; low for member retention, partner conversion and business economics.
